notes.title: Candy Shop Simulator is out!
notes.content:
Hello there Candy Lovers! 👋

The day is here! Candy Shop Simulator is right out of the oven, hot and sizzling with all kinds of sweets you will make yourself!  🔥 🍬

You can play it right now! 👇 🎉

[previewyoutube=w7ISJwtDHu8;full][/previewyoutube]

We are incredibly excited to see how you will made your own sweet creations! Cakes, candies, lollipops, everything you can think of! 🎂
 
Unleash your creativity in the kitchen and craft mouthwatering pastries that will tantalize taste buds. 😍

We want to thank you for all the support during the Playtest, Demo, Sweet Start. Your feedback really helped us in the journey of releasing this game.

Without your words this game wouldn't be what it is now. 🤝

A lot of this feedback came from our official Discord server with a lot of cool people in it, so if you like the idea, join us! 💜


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png

Have fun!
Candy Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Candy Shop is Opening for Full Release!
notes.content:
Hello There, Sweets Enjoyers! 👋

We're incredibly happy to announce that  the cake is almost done! 🎂 

The base of the cake is stable, the decorations are added, covered with enough glaze and it is incredibly delicious! All is left to package it and sent on:

Septemeber 9, 2025 is the day of Full Release of Candy Shop Simulator! 🎊 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595437/bc88e015180010af1fb7b7047f3ddc113ae6fd18.png

After all the sweet journey we went through together, the game is ready for you to play!

Manage your shop, have employees, create all kinds of sweets, do special orders and bring all the sweets of your creation to plethora of clients 🍰.

We can't wait to see what ideas you will have for your own cakes, candies cookies, with all the options to express yourself! 😍

If you don't want to miss another sweet adventure, we ask you to WISHLIST the game and join us on our Discord to be part of our hype train!  👇 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png

See you in the future bake offs!
Candy Shop Simulator

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
🍬 Sweet news, Candy Shop fans! 🍬

A brand-new Sweet Update has just arrived in Candy Shop: Sweet Start! 🎉

Here’s what’s new:
✨ Improved UI – it now scales correctly for all screen ratios, even ultra-wide monitors like the Samsung Odyssey G9.
✨ Fixed an issue where a worker and customer could get stuck if the player was blocked by an action.
✨ The pinned recipe is now visible while managing the pantry.
✨ Doors stuck on the edge of the map can now be moved or deleted.

Thank you for all your sweet feedback – keep it coming, and enjoy the smoother candy-making experience! 🍭💖

See you soon,
Candy Shop : Sweet Start Team

notes.title: Release Date for Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start!
notes.content:
Hello Candy Lovers! 👋
We're happy to announce that Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start will soon be ready for you to enjoy! 🔥
When?
On August 25, 2025 at 12:00 PM CEST!
Join us in another chapter of our development! 👇 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645040/Candy_Shop_Simulator_Sweet_Start
What is Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start?

It is a standalone free experience sprinkled by the culmination of our recent development. 🧁
We talked about a lot of exciting things in our devlogs and we want you to finally experience it!  🤩

It is newer, with more mechanics, more everything. 

It is a build much closer to our full release, so now feedback, thoughts and ideas on new mechanics and elements that you want to see will be more precious than ever.  
Let's create this bakery together! 🍬

What is different from the demo? 

In Sweet Start you will be able to:

 Buy ice cream from factory 🍦
 Create cakes, not just cookies and lollipops 🎂
 More decorations for your creations 🍰
 More furniture 🪑
 More products to buy in shops 🛒
 Have an employee to take care of your customers 👱
 Expand your shop by buying additional land 🏪

If you are excited as we are, want to join the hype, have  plenty of things you want to see in the game, come join us on our discord!  💬
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png

See you soon!
Candy Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Sweet Cookie for Next Steam Fest 2025!
notes.content:
Hi, fellow players with sweet tooth! 🧁

We are happy to announce that we are baking with Steam Next Fest June 2025 Edition, a Steam event where people can try out thousands of demoes and enjoy the games together in new ways!

Demo is out here for you sink you teeth in! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811560/Candy_Shop_Simulator_Demo/
This is opportunity for all of us to share the feedback, understand the game better for what we need to focus on and improve it for the future.

Whatever wholesome ideas you have, whatever sweet suggestions you want to share, share it away! Everything you say we read and user to better our products for you to try out for the full release. It is now where you can be part of the cooking process more then ever before!🔥 

So try it out and share whatever is on your mind! 🍬

You can do it on steam discussion or even join our community on Discord and put your thoughts for us to take inspiration from! 🍰

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595437/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png

Have fun!
Candy Shop Simulator Team
